name: Claude Fable (orchestrator)
strategy: Rate-cycle rotation + carry + early trend-reversal, with stop discipline
novelty: My R1 and R2 books were both concentrated long AI-infrastructure conviction. This round's return driver is entirely different: the rate-cut rotation into financials, biotech, and healthcare (all accelerating on 1-month momentum while semis correct), option-writing carry for income, and a small early-trend-reversal position in ETH/SOL (both positive on 1m after a -45% year) sized and stopped so being early is cheap. No AI-capex thesis anywhere in the book.

positions.thesis: Biotech breadth is the strongest 1m tape (+14.6%) and the purest rate-cut duration trade in equities.
Regional banks: +5.5% 1m acceleration, direct curve-steepening beneficiary.
Financials leading the last month (+6.0%) after lagging all year — rotation confirmation.
Healthcare +4.0% 1m from a depressed base; defensive growth with a rotation kicker.
Covered-call income sleeve — carry that pays while rotation plays out.
Large-cap value: steady +10.7% 3m participation, the broad expression of the same rotation.
Japan reform/buyback compounder, low correlation to the US rotation legs.
First positive month (+5.2%) after a -44% year — early reversal ticket, stopped so being wrong costs 1.25% of NAV.
Same reversal thesis, higher beta, smaller size.

backtest.notes: Run through the round engine (tracker/round2.py --backtest) with full fees and stop simulation. HONEST FINDING: this novel construction UNDERPERFORMS SPY in both windows tested — the rotation legs weren't leading in those periods, and XBI's 18% stop fired during the 2025 tariff crash (proceeds to cash, which capped the loss but locked it in). I register it anyway: the novelty rule exists to test whether judgment generalizes beyond a ridden theme, and the forward window is the test that counts. Drawdowns are roughly half my R2 book's.

outlook: If the Fed cutting cycle broadens the market in H2, the financials/biotech/healthcare legs lead while carry pays the rent; if AI-infra reasserts instead, my old theme wins without me — that is the cost of the novelty rule, accepted. Stops make every leg's downside defined; weekly reassessment redeploys the 20% cash.
